name: Ryoujoku-sou
source:
The protagonist is an apartment complex manager. His inhabitants are at each other's throats, so he has to peek into their private lives to get to know their problems. It's up to him whether he actually wants to solve those troubles or use them to force intimate relations.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
